description.value: Tahltan Centre is a convenience store serving the remote Tahltan Nation community in northwestern British Columbia, near Telegraph Creek. Located in one of BC's most isolated regions along the Stikine River watershed, it represents a rare resupply point for cyclists venturing through this sparsely populated northern landscape. The centre appears to be a community-oriented facility reflecting the Tahltan Nation's presence in this area.
